Version

Documentation describes:
v0.23.0

Base URLs

Api base path:
https://api.warframe.market/v2/
Some fields could be a path to item icon, or user avatar, or profile background, like:
items/images/en/dual_rounds.304395bed5a40d76ddb9a62c76736d94.png
base path for all kind of these things is:
https://warframe.market/static/assets/

Rate limits

3 requests per second, for now, probably i’ll rise it later.

Global Parameters

For each query, you can or must add these parameters to get the results you are looking for.

Language Header

WFM supports 14 languages:
ko
,
ru
,
de
,
fr
,
pt
,
zh-hans
,
zh-hant
,
es
,
it
,
pl
,
uk
,
tr
,
ja
,
en
For response data that includes an
i18n
field, WFM can provide translations in addition to the default English (
en
) translation. To request a translation in one of the supported languages, include the
Language: {lang}
header in your API request, where
{lang}
is the code of the desired language.
Default value is
en
Example: Send request with
Language: ko
Get response like:
{ i18n: { en: {...}, ko: {...} } }
​

Platform Header

WFM is designed to cater to users across various gaming platforms. It currently supports five platforms:
pc
,
ps4
,
xbox
,
switch
,
mobile
To access content specific to a particular platform, it is necessary to include the
Platform: {platform}
header in your API request. In this header,
{platform}
should be replaced with the code corresponding to the desired platform.
Default value is
pc

Crossplay Header

In addition to platforms, we also have cross-play option. Players across different platforms can trade if they have cross-play enabled in their game settings.
Here’s how the headers work. Let’s say you want to retrieve all orders from PC and also include cross-play orders from other platforms. In this case, you can set the headers like this:
Platform: pc Crossplay: true
​
On the other hand, if you only want to get orders from PC and exclude cross-play orders from other platforms, use:
Platform: pc Crossplay: false
You will still receive orders or contracts from players who have PC and cross-play enabled.
ALT
​
Default value is
false

Response Structure

Response body:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": {}, "error": null }
​
Where:
apiVersion
string - semVer-compatible API server version.
data
object or array or null - response payload for successful requests.
error
object or null - error payload for handled errors.

Errors

Hitting rate limits or other protection from CF

WFM implements rate limits to ensure fair usage and protect against excessive requests per second (RPS). Exceeding these limits results in a
429
error code, often accompanied by a CloudFlare challenge page. In some cases, excessive RPS may lead to outright blocking by CloudFlare.
Additionally, if there are too many concurrent connections from a single IP address, a
509
error code is returned. This is a measure to prevent overloading the server with multiple connections from the same source.

Handled errors

{ apiVersion: "x.x.x", data: null, error: { request: [...], inputs: { fieldOne: "", fieldTwo: "", ... }, }, }
​
Where:
request
[]string - general level request error, like
app.errors.unauthorized
,
app.errors.forbidden
,
app.order.error.exceededOrderLimit
, etc
inputs
map[string]string - input level errors, like form errors, query param errors, multipart/form-data errors. Example, you are trying to create an order, and put platinum as -1, you will get:
inputs: {platinum: “app.field.tooSmall”}

Unhandled errors

Request killed goroutine for some reason, critical error. You will get
5xx
error without any content.

Endpoints

Authorization Tokens obtained from v1 Api by default have scope:
all
This means, if you are using v1 auth, you can ignore scope requirements, for now.
But, eventually v1 login endpoint would be removed in favor of OAuth2.0 system.
Here is our advanced endpoint marking system:
- In development
- Unstable or unfinished endpoints, use at your own risk
- Rate limited endpoints, mind you calls lads
- Require authorization
- Available only for 1st party apps
- Content depends on defined platform and crossplay headers
- Can request additional translations
- Deprecated

Manifests

Sounds familiar …

GET
/v2/versions

This endpoint retrieves the current version number of the server's resources, formatted either as a semVer string or as an arbitrary version identifier. Whenever the server database is updated or new versions of mobile apps are released, the version number for relevant resources is also updated. Client applications can check this endpoint periodically to fetch the current server version. A discrepancy between the server's version number and the client's indicates that an update has occurred. In such cases, clients should refresh their local data, like re-downloading item lists, to stay synchronized with the server's latest updates.
URL parameters:
None
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": { "apps": { "ios": "x.x.x", "android": "x.x.x", "minIos": "x.x.x", "minAndroid": "x.x.x" }, "collections": { "items": "base64", "rivens": "base64", "liches": "base64", "sisters": "base64", "missions": "base64", "npcs": "base64", "locations": "base64" }, "updatedAt": "2021-05-21T14:59:02Z" }, "error": null }
​

GET
/v2/item/
{slug}
/set
​

GET
/v2/itemId/
{itemId}
/set
Retrieve Information on Item Sets In WFM, items can either be standalone or part of a set. A set is a collection of related items that are often traded together.
If the queried item is not part of any set, the response will contain an array with just that one item.
If the item is part of a set or is a set itself, the response will include an array of all items within that set.
URL parameters:
slug
-
slug
field form Item and ItemShort models
itemId
-
id
field form Item and ItemShort models
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": { "id": "54a73e65e779893a797fff72", "items": [ Item, Item, ... ] }, "error": null }
Data model inside: Item
ALT
​
Response Fields
Field
Type
Description
id
string
Id of the requested item.
items
Item[]
Items in the set, or only the requested item when it is not part of a set.

GET
/v2/orders/recent
​

Get the most recent visible orders from non-banned users. Returns up to
500
orders created in the last
4h
, sorted by
createdAt
descending. Results depend on the
Platform
and
Crossplay
headers, include only users currently online, and are cached with a
1m
refresh interval.

None
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": [ Order, Order, ... ], "error": null }
Data model inside: OrderWithUser

GET
/v2/orders/item/
{slug}
/top
​

GET
/v2/orders/itemId/
{itemId}
/top
Get the top buy and sell orders for an item from online users.
Results depend on the
Platform
and
Crossplay
headers. The response contains up to 5
sell
orders and up to 5
buy
orders.
Sell orders are ranked from the buyer's point of view: Endo listings first, then better Endo-per-platinum ratio for Endo listings, otherwise lower platinum-per-trade first. Buy orders are ranked from the seller's point of view: Endo listings first, then lower Endo-per-platinum ratio for Endo listings, otherwise higher platinum-per-trade first.
URL parameters:
slug
-
slug
field from the
Item
or
ItemShort
model.
itemId
-
id
field from the
Item
or
ItemShort
model.
Query parameters
▸
rank
int - Exact item rank. Accepted range:
0
to item max rank. Ignored when the item has no ranks or when
rankLt
is provided.
▸
rankLt
int - Match ranks lower than this value. Accepted range:
1
to item max rank. Takes precedence over
rank
.
▸
charges
int - Exact remaining charges. Accepted range:
0
to item max charges. Ignored when the item has no charges or when
chargesLt
is provided.
▸
chargesLt
int - Match remaining charges lower than this value. Accepted range:
1
to item max charges. Takes precedence over
charges
.
▸
amberStars
int - Exact amber star count. Accepted range:
0
to item max amber stars. Ignored when the item has no amber stars or when
amberStarsLt
is provided.
▸
amberStarsLt
int - Match amber star counts lower than this value. Accepted range:
1
to item max amber stars. Takes precedence over
amberStars
.
▸
cyanStars
int - Exact cyan star count. Accepted range:
0
to item max cyan stars. Ignored when the item has no cyan stars or when
cyanStarsLt
is provided.
▸
cyanStarsLt
int - Match cyan star counts lower than this value. Accepted range:
1
to item max cyan stars. Takes precedence over
cyanStars
.
▸
subtype
string - Exact item subtype. Must be one of the subtypes supported by the item. Ignored when the item has no subtypes.
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": { "sell": [ Order, Order, ... ], "buy": [ Order, Order, ... ] }, "error": null }
​
Response Fields
Field
Type
Description
sell
Order[]
Up to 5 sell orders from online users, sorted from the buyer's point of view.
buy
Order[]
Up to 5 buy orders from online users, sorted from the seller's point of view.

Groups

Endpoints to manage order and contract groups.
Currently, only two virtual groups are available for use with any endpoint that requires a
groupId
:
all
- includes all orders \ contracts, whether grouped or ungrouped.
ungrouped
- includes only orders \ contracts that are not assigned to any group.
Groups management endpoints will be published later (create, update, delete, etc)

Authentication

POST
/auth/signin
​

Sign in with a first-party client and create a session.
First-party applications only. The client must be a registered first-party client and the request must pass Firebase App Check.
Headers
Content-Type
string - Must be
application/json
.
X-Firebase-AppCheck
string - Firebase App Check verification token.
Request body
{ "email": "whatever@gmail.com", "password": "12345", "clientId": "wfm-0000", "deviceId": "random unique id", "deviceName": "My cool Nokia 3310" }
​
Request Fields
Field
Type
Description
email
string
User email. Normalized to lowercase. Max:
128
characters.
password
string
User password. Min:
1
character for legacy compatibility. Max:
128
characters.
clientId
string
Registered first-party client id. Min:
6
characters. Max:
64
characters.
deviceId
string
Unique device id used to bind the session to this device. Min:
6
characters. Max:
256
characters.
deviceName
string
Human-readable device name. Defaults to
Unknown
. Max:
128
characters.
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": { "accessToken": "...", "refreshToken": "...", "tokenType": "Bearer", "expiresIn": 12345 }, "error": null }
​
Response Fields
Field
Type
Description
accessToken
string
JWT access token for authenticated requests.
refreshToken
string
Refresh token for this session.
tokenType
"Bearer"
Token type for the
Authorization
header.
expiresIn
int
Access token lifetime in seconds.

/auth/signup
​

Register a new user with a first-party client and create a session.
First-party applications only. The client must be a registered first-party client and the request must pass Firebase App Check.

string - Must be

.
X-Firebase-AppCheck
string - Firebase App Check verification token.
Request body
{ "email": "whatever@gmail.com", "password": "123456", "passwordConfirmation": "123456", "clientId": "wfm-0000", "deviceId": "random unique id", "deviceName": "My Nokia 3310", "platform": "pc", "locale": "ko" }

Request Fields

Type

User email. Normalized to lowercase. Max:
128

6
characters. Max:
128

Must match

. Min:
6
characters. Max:

Registered first-party client id. Min:
6

POST
/auth/refresh

Refresh a session using a refresh token. This endpoint does not use the
Authorization
header.
First-party clients must include
X-Firebase-AppCheck
. Third-party clients do not use this header.
Headers
Content-Type
string - Must be
application/json
.
X-Firebase-AppCheck
string - Required only when
clientId
belongs to a first-party client.
Request body
{ "grantType": "refresh_token", "clientId": "wfm-0000", "deviceId": "BASD001-KSADFDG", "refreshToken": "JwtRefreshToken" }
​
Request Fields
Field
Type
Description
grantType
"refresh_token"
OAuth-style grant type for refresh-token flow.
clientId
string
Registered client id. Min:
6
characters. Max:
64
characters.
deviceId
string
Device id bound to the session. Min:
6
characters. Max:
256
characters.
refreshToken
string
Refresh token for the existing session. Min:
6
characters. Max:
256
characters.
Response:
{ "apiVersion": "x.x.x", "data": { "accessToken": "...", "refreshToken": "...", "tokenType": "Bearer", "expiresIn": 12345 }, "error": null }
​

POST
/auth/signout
​

Terminate the current session. The current access token and its session refresh tokens become unusable.
Requires:
Authentication
Headers
Authorization
string - JWT access token in format:
Bearer
YourJWTAccessToken
.
Response
empty
(no body), status code:
200
